_readme: UI chrome strings, one object per language. Keys are stable ids; English is
the reference and is used as the fallback whenever a key is missing, so a
half-finished language degrades to English words rather than to blanks.
These are the strings that appear on EVERY page. The per-page prose lives in
pages.<lang>.json instead, because that is the part with search value and the
part that has to be translated slug by slug.
Translated by Claude and NOT yet reviewed by a native speaker. The nav and
button strings are low-risk; the tagline and anything that ends up in a
<title> or meta description is marketing copy and deserves a human pass.
